title: Thomas Osborne Davis
html_source:
Thomas Osborne Davis, (born Oct. 14, 1814, Mallow, County Cork, Ire.—died Sept. 16, 1845, Dublin) Irish writer and politician who was the chief organizer and poet of the Young Ireland movement…Davis wrote patriotic verses such as “A Nation Once Again” and “The Battle of Fontenoy”; his writings virtually became the gospel of the Sinn Féin movement.
Encyclopedia Britannica
